title: Outcome of Renal Transplant on a Defunctionalized Bladder
brief_summary: In this study, investigators will prospectively evaluate the outcome of renal transplantation into a defunctionalized bladder by comparing direct transplantation into this defunctionalized bladder and pre-transplant programmed bladder cycling.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients maintained on hemodialysis for more than 12 months
* have oliguria or anuria
* reduced bladder capacity
* have no history of lower urinary tract dysfunction and have no evidence of urological cause of renal failure.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with history of lower urinary tract symptoms before developing renal failure and
* those with lower urinary tract disease resulting in renal failure will be excluded
condition: Renal Transplantation Into a Defunctionalized Bladder
